usefulness.rationale: The dossier body and retained sources are empty; only identity anchors are present. Understanding is 0 (no substantive content beyond anchors), remainingQuestions is 0 (the dossier does not articulate any epistemic limits — it is simply absent), conversationReadiness is 0 (a reader could only state his title and dates, nothing to prepare a discussion from). Uncertain is not set: the emptiness makes the judgment clear-cut.
